segs.en: It's Halloween night, and ghosts and vampires have gathered for the Monster Mash!

zh.ai: 今晚是万圣节之夜，鬼魂和吸血鬼聚集在一起参加怪物舞会！

segs.en: There are $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) monsters standing in a row. Each monster is either a ghost (G) or a vampire (V).

zh.ai: 有 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)只怪物站成一排。每只怪物要么是鬼魂(G)，要么是吸血鬼(V)。

segs.en: Whenever two adjacent monsters are of the same type, they can fuse into one monster of the opposite type:

zh.ai: 每当两个相邻的怪物类型相同时，它们就可以融合成一个类型相反的怪物：

segs.en: The new monster takes the place of the original two, and all other monsters keep their relative order. You may perform these fusions in any order, as many times as you like.

zh.ai: 新怪物会取代原来的两个怪物，其他所有怪物保持相对顺序不变。你可以按任意顺序进行这些融合，次数不限。

segs.en: What is the minimum number of monsters that can remain?

zh.ai: 最多可以剩下多少只怪物？

segs.en: The first line contains an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$), the number of monsters.

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$($$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)，表示怪物的数量。

segs.en: The second line contains a string of length $$$n$$$, consisting only of the characters G and V, representing the monsters from left to right.

zh.ai: 第二行包含一个长度为 $$$n$$$ 的字符串，仅由字符 G 和 V 组成，表示从左到右排列的怪物。

segs.en: Print a single integer: the minimum possible number of monsters remaining after performing any number of valid fusions.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数：进行任意次合法融合后剩余怪物数量的最小值。

segs.en:
In the sample, one possible sequence of fusions is 
$$\texttt{GGVV}\rightarrow\texttt{VVV}\rightarrow\texttt{GV}.$$ No further fusion is possible. The only other possible first fusion produces GGG. From either VVV or GGG, the next fusion leaves GV or VG, so every choice stops at two monsters. Therefore, the answer is $$$2$$$.

zh.ai: 在样例中，一种可能的融合序列是 $$$$$$\texttt{GGVV}\rightarrow\texttt{VVV}\rightarrow\texttt{GV}.$$$$$$ No further fusion is possible. The only other possible first fusion produces GGG. From either VVV or GGG, the next fusion leaves GV or VG, so every choice stops at two monsters. Therefore, the answer is $$$2$$$。
